lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Thanks for calling — this is AVA. What's going on with your system?

lines.speaker: CALLER
lines.text: Yeah, my AC died about an hour ago. It's ninety-one degrees in my house right now.

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Ninety-one — that's miserable. Let's get you cooled down fast. Is the unit doing anything at all, or completely dead?

lines.speaker: CALLER
lines.text: Completely dead. Breaker looks fine, I already checked the—

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Got it — dead unit, breaker's good. That's exactly what the tech needs to know.

lines.speaker: CALLER
lines.text: How much is this gonna run me?

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: The diagnostic visit is eighty-nine dollars, and it's waived if you go ahead with the repair. First opening is tomorrow at nine A-M — want it?

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Nine A-M, locked in. I'm texting your confirmation right now — reply to that text if anything changes.

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Stay near a fan tonight, Mike. We've got you.

job.label: Job
job.value: AC dead — no power, breaker OK
